title: Clickety Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Beneath shafts of twilight-blue water and swaying forests of translucent glass-kelp, this inquisitive cephalopod spends its days sorting luminous sea-pebbles into intricate geometric spirals across the sandy floor. Whenever a visitor leans close, its skin ripples with dazzling kaleidoscopic patterns as it excitedly clicks its favorite shiny treasures together like tiny castanets.
